title: MockWeights
description: Weights of the generic decision mock (Bogen 34 R26): the mock in the AI service and in the core picks among the offered options by these weights, the same integer rule on both sides (tests/mock/cases.json). No branch for any single option: changing only these data changes the result (A3); weight 0 means the mock never picks that action while another option has weight.

default_permille.description: Weight of an action without its own entry, in permille.

action.description: Action id from the action vocabulary.

permille.description: Weight of this action, in permille (0 = never while another option has weight).
